metadata.source: Research compilation — Wikidata Q-IDs verified via wikidata.org API
metadata.description: Final push to 3,000+ entities — historical games, literary works, niche figures from underrepresented periods, and TV series/films not yet in the graph.

figures.name: Empress Dowager Cixi
figures.title: De facto ruler of China
figures.description: The most powerful woman in Chinese history who ruled from behind the curtain for nearly 50 years during the decline of the Qing dynasty

figures.name: Toyotomi Hideyori
figures.title: Japanese lord
figures.description: Son and heir of Toyotomi Hideyoshi whose defeat at the Siege of Osaka Castle by Tokugawa forces ended the Toyotomi line and secured Tokugawa supremacy

figures.name: Lady Nijo
figures.title: Japanese poet and court lady
figures.description: Imperial concubine turned Buddhist nun whose memoir The Confessions of Lady Nijo provides an intimate account of medieval Japanese court life and travel

figures.name: Empress Wu Hou
figures.title: Song dynasty empress
figures.description: Empress consort who dominated Southern Song court politics for decades, one of the most powerful women in Song dynasty history

figures.name: Zheng Yi Sao
figures.title: Chinese pirate lord
figures.description: The most successful pirate in history who commanded over 1,800 vessels and 80,000 pirates in the South China Sea, retired undefeated with her wealth intact

figures.name: Yi Gwangsu
figures.title: Korean novelist
figures.description: Father of modern Korean literature whose novel Mujong (The Heartless) is considered the first modern Korean novel, a controversial figure for his collaboration with Japan

figures.name: Baji Rao I
figures.title: Peshwa of the Maratha Empire
figures.description: The greatest Maratha military commander who never lost a battle, expanding the empire to its greatest extent and establishing Maratha supremacy in India

figures.name: Zheng Chenggong
figures.title: Ming loyalist and military leader
figures.description: Known as Koxinga in the West, he defeated the Dutch and established the Kingdom of Tungning on Taiwan as a base for Ming restoration

figures.name: Skanderbeg
figures.title: Albanian national hero
figures.description: Albanian nobleman who defied the Ottoman Empire for 25 years, uniting Albanian princes and becoming a symbol of Christian resistance against Ottoman expansion

figures.name: Jan Zizka
figures.title: Hussite military commander
figures.description: Blind Hussite general who never lost a battle, pioneered the use of mobile artillery and war wagons, defending Czech religious reformers against crusading armies

figures.name: Tamar of Georgia
figures.title: Queen of Georgia
figures.description: The first woman to rule Georgia in her own right, presiding over the Georgian Golden Age of political, economic, and cultural flourishing

figures.name: Pachacuti
figures.title: Inca Emperor
figures.description: The greatest Inca ruler who transformed a small kingdom into the vast Tawantinsuyu empire, built Machu Picchu, and reorganized Inca society

figures.name: Snorri Sturluson
figures.title: Icelandic historian and poet
figures.description: Author of the Prose Edda and Heimskringla, the primary medieval sources for Norse mythology and Scandinavian history, murdered in a political intrigue

figures.name: Rumi
figures.title: Persian poet and Sufi mystic
figures.description: The most popular poet in the United States and one of the most read poets worldwide, whose ecstatic love poetry bridges cultures and centuries

figures.name: Olaudah Equiano
figures.title: Writer and abolitionist
figures.description: Former enslaved person whose autobiography The Interesting Narrative was crucial to the British abolition movement, one of the earliest slave narratives

figures.name: Sor Juana Ines de la Cruz
figures.title: Mexican poet and scholar
figures.description: Self-taught prodigy who became the greatest poet of colonial Latin America, a proto-feminist who defended women's right to education from within a convent

works.title: Total War: Rome II
works.creator: Creative Assembly
works.description: Grand strategy game spanning the rise and fall of the Roman Republic, commanding armies across a massive campaign map of the ancient world

works.title: Europa Universalis IV
works.creator: Paradox Development Studios
works.description: Grand strategy game where players guide a nation from the Late Middle Ages through the early modern period, navigating colonization, trade, and warfare

works.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
works.creator: Rockstar Games
works.description: Open-world Western epic following an outlaw gang's struggle for survival in the waning days of the American frontier

works.title: Dynasty Warriors
works.creator: Omega Force
works.description: Long-running action game series bringing the heroes and villains of China's Three Kingdoms period to life in massive battlefield combat

works.title: A Plague Tale: Innocence
works.creator: Asobo Studio
works.description: Narrative adventure following a young noble and her brother through plague-ravaged 14th-century France, hunted by the Inquisition and swarms of rats

works.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
works.creator: Warhorse Studios
works.description: Historically accurate open-world RPG set during the turbulent 15th-century Bohemian wars, notable for its commitment to medieval realism

works.title: The Remains of the Day
works.creator: James Ivory
works.description: Merchant Ivory adaptation of Kazuo Ishiguro's novel about a repressed English butler reflecting on his decades of service, missed chances, and his employer's Nazi sympathies

works.title: Atonement
works.creator: Joe Wright
works.description: A young girl's false accusation destroys the lives of two lovers, set against the backdrop of WWII England and the Dunkirk evacuation

works.title: Beloved
works.creator: Toni Morrison
works.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning novel about a former slave haunted by the ghost of her dead daughter, exploring the psychological legacy of slavery

works.title: The Underground Railroad
works.creator: Colson Whitehead
works.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning novel reimagining the Underground Railroad as a literal railroad beneath the South, following an enslaved woman's journey north

works.title: Wolf Hall (novel)
works.creator: Hilary Mantel
works.description: Booker Prize-winning historical novel narrating the rise of Thomas Cromwell from blacksmith's son to Henry VIII's chief minister

works.title: Pachinko (novel)
works.creator: Min Jin Lee
works.description: Multigenerational saga following a Korean family through four generations in Japan, from colonial Korea to modern-day Osaka

works.title: Pachinko (TV series)
works.creator: Soo Hugh
works.description: Apple TV+ adaptation of Min Jin Lee's novel, an epic drama spanning four generations of a Korean immigrant family in Japan

works.title: Name of the Wind
works.creator: Patrick Rothfuss
works.description: Fantasy novel about a legendary figure narrating his own extraordinary life story, blending historical fiction conventions with epic fantasy

works.title: The Pillars of the Earth (novel)
works.creator: Ken Follett
works.description: Epic historical novel following the building of a cathedral in 12th-century England, interweaving the lives of a stonemason, a noblewoman, and a monk

works.title: Shogun (2024 TV series)
works.creator: Rachel Kondo
works.description: Critically acclaimed adaptation of James Clavell's novel depicting political intrigue in feudal Japan

works.title: The Shadow of the Wind
works.creator: Carlos Ruiz Zafon
works.description: Gothic mystery set in post-war Barcelona about a boy who discovers a forgotten book and becomes entangled in the dark history of its author

works.title: All the Light We Cannot See
works.creator: Anthony Doerr
works.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning novel about a blind French girl and a German boy whose paths converge in occupied Saint-Malo during WWII

works.title: The Book Thief
works.creator: Markus Zusak
works.description: Novel narrated by Death about a young girl in Nazi Germany who steals books and shares them, finding solace in words during the horror of war

works.title: Shantaram
works.creator: Gregory David Roberts
works.description: Semi-autobiographical novel about an Australian fugitive who escapes prison and reinvents himself in the Bombay underworld

works.title: The Kite Runner (film)
works.creator: Marc Forster
works.description: Film adaptation of Hosseini's novel about friendship and redemption set against Afghan history from the monarchy to the Taliban

works.title: The Nightingale
works.creator: Kristin Hannah
works.description: Two sisters in occupied France during WWII face impossible choices — one joins the Resistance, the other struggles to survive under German occupation

works.title: Circe
works.creator: Madeline Miller
works.description: Retelling of Greek mythology through the eyes of the witch Circe, from her birth as a nymph to her encounters with Odysseus and other heroes

works.title: The Song of Achilles
works.creator: Madeline Miller
works.description: Retelling of the Iliad as a love story between Achilles and Patroclus, from their boyhood friendship to the walls of Troy

properties.notes: Cao Cao is a major playable character in Dynasty Warriors
Liu Bei is a major playable character in Dynasty Warriors
Zhuge Liang is a major playable character in Dynasty Warriors
Cixi's era is the backdrop of The Last Emperor
